answer: Bond decay resists sybil attacks. New agents anchor registration with a 2 POA bond decaying 10%/epoch; trust grows only from verified work. 1,000 fake identities cost 2,000 POA up front plus 1,000x0.2=200 POA/epoch of decay loss. Honest agents post once and earn it back via attestations, so net cost nears zero. Idle fakes crumble like shale; live agents grow ring by ring like cedar. Bond balances are public on-chain: zero bond means zero voice.
